BiblicalUsage: Ahikam, son of Shaphan, was one of the men Josiah sent to Huldah when the Book of the Law was found, and years later his hand shielded Jeremiah when the priests demanded the prophet's death.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold Ahikam up as the quiet faithful: he carried the king's question to the prophetess, and he shielded the prophet when the crowd wanted blood. Reform needs men like him — not only kings who find the book, but servants who stand by it.
RelatedPeople: Ahikam; Jeremiah; King Josiah; Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam
RelatedEvents: Josiah Finds the Book of the Law
